title_fil: Profiling ng sambahayan at mga target list
objectives_fil: Piliin ang tamang record para sa bawat gawain at ilipat ang impormasyong kailangan lamang sa awtorisadong staff.
Punan ang kasalukuyang lokal na profile, markahan ang nabagong impormasyon, at kumpirmahin ang hindi tiyak sa pamilya.
Piliin ang awtorisadong field, iwasan ang duplicate, at ipasa nang pribado ang WRA at buntis/postpartum list sa midwife.
Iuri ang bawat bata ayon sa kasalukuyang form, i-update ang target list, at markahan ang follow-up na kailangang kumpirmahin.
I-update ang adult at senior list ayon sa lokal na form at ituro ang angkop na nasuring serbisyo.
Punan ang apat na bahagi ng aprubadong environmental form at iulat ang tiyak na concern sa supervisor.
Hanapin ang hindi tugma, itama gamit ang pinagmulan ng impormasyon, markahan ang hindi pa tiyak, at ipasa nang pribado.
objectives_en: Given synthetic service events, choose ITR, household profile, or target list and identify who maintains it.
Given a fictional household change, complete and update the locally approved profile.
Given fictional profiles, identify eligible entries for WRA and pregnancy/postpartum lists and hand them to the midwife.
Given fictional ages and services, update newborn, infant, child/adolescent and oral-health target lists.
Given fictional adults, update NCD and older-person lists and identify a reviewed follow-up service.
Given a fictional household WASH survey, complete the four-part local sanitation record and hand over a concern.
Given several synthetic forms, find missing/contradictory entries, correct from source, and prepare a confidential supervisor handover.
summary_fil: Profiling ng sambahayan at mga target list: 7 aralin na may kaso, pagsasanay at observer sheet.
summary_en: Household profiling and target lists: 7 lessons with cases, practice and observer sheets.
